   \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \left| x_1(y_2 - y_3) + x_2(y_3 - y_1) + x_3(y_1 - y_2) \right|
   \]

   \[
   \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \left| 1(1 - 1) + 1(1 - 0) + 2(0 - 1) \right| = \frac{1}{2} \left| 1 \right| = \frac{1}{2}
   \]
